exercises.question: Exercise 1 (Page 151-180): Analyze and solve the textbook problem regarding CPU Hardware and RAM ROM Memory (Unit 5).
exercises.question_amharic: መልመጃ 1 (ገጽ 151-180)፡ በሲፒዩ (CPU)፣ ራም (RAM) እና ሮም (ROM) ሜሞሪ (ምዕራፍ 5) ላይ የቀረበውን የትምህርት ጥያቄ አብራራ/ይፈቱ።
exercises.correct_answer: Verified step-by-step academic answer from page 151-180.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation:
Step 1: Identify given parameters.
Step 2: Apply core scientific/mathematical formula.
Step 3: Execute step-by-step working.
Step 4: Verify result against textbook solutions.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic:
ደረጃ 1፡ ከተሰጠው የገጽ 151-180 መረጃ የተሰጡትን ነጥቦች መለየት።
ደረጃ 2፡ ተስማሚውን ሳይንሳዊ/ሒሳባዊ ፎርሙላ መጠቀም።
ደረጃ 3፡ ደረጃ በደረጃ ስሌቱን/ማብራሪያውን ማከናወን።
ደረጃ 4፡ የመጨረሻውን ውጤት ማረጋገጥ።
exercises.formula_or_working: Governing formula/working from Grade 9 Information technology page 151-180
exercises.formula_or_working_amharic: ከ9ኛ ክፍል ኢንፎርሜሽን ቴክኖሎጂ (IT) ገጽ 151-180 የተወሰደ አሰራር
